description: Use this after you have confirmed an unknown Idempotency-Key did not send, or you accept the risk of sending again. Requires auth and message_send. Inputs: key (required). Deletes an unknown key, including a stale in_progress row older than the 10 minute lease, so the same key can be reused. Returns {key, released:true}. A done key is HTTP 409 idempotency_key_done and still replays. A fresh in_progress key is HTTP 409 idempotency_request_in_progress. A missing key is HTTP 404 idempotency_key_not_found.
name: cooper_release_idempotency_key

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

endpoint.description: Endpoint the key was used on.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object expires, or null for no expiry.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

last_error.description: Last error seen for this key, when any.

message_id.description: Message id (msg_…) this result refers to.

released.description: True when the key was released for reuse.

unknown_since.description: ISO-8601 time the outcome became unknown, when it did.

title: Release idempotency key
